rules: No Inter, Roboto, or generic fonts for headings.
Line height: leading-none for metrics/headers, leading-relaxed for body.
Use JetBrains Mono for API keys, logs, latency metrics, and token counts.
Avoid teal green or teal blue (#1B93A4) for dashboards.
Always set text color on hover (e.g., hover:bg-slate-100 hover:text-slate-900).
Tinted greys only (slate), never pure black/grey.

layouts.strategy: Mode B: High Density Grid (For Dashboards / Analytics)
layouts.navigation: Sidebar (w-64) + Sticky Top Header. Sidebar holds main routes (Dashboard, Projects, Usage, Costs, Reliability, Optimization, Settings). Header holds global context (Workspace, Date Picker) and 'Manual Seed Demo Data' button.
rules: Grid items MUST be direct children of grid containers.
Responsive scaling: mobile-first, single column defaulting to larger grids.

surfaces.header: Crystal Glass style: bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-slate-200 shadow-sm. Never completely transparent.
surfaces.cards: Flat background (bg-white), 1px solid border (border-slate-200), rounded-xl, no shadow by default. Hover: shadow-sm -translate-y-[1px] transition-all.
surfaces.tables: Dense, crisp. Left-aligned text, right-aligned numbers. border-collapse with border-b border-slate-100. Sticky headers for long tables.
surfaces.modals: bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-2xl border border-slate-100 p-6.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped or rounded-lg. Distinct hover/focus states.
components.inputs: Shadcn default inputs, styled with rounded-lg, border-slate-200, focus rings.
components.charts: Recharts. Clean, minimal axes, hidden grid or very light dashed lines. Accessible data-ink ratio.
components.api_keys: Reveal-once modal layout. Large monospace block, one-click copy with toast.
components.empty_states: Action-oriented. Dashed border container (border-slate-300), subtle muted icon, clear descriptive text, primary CTA button.
components.date_picker: Global sticky filter in header controlling context for all metrics (24h/7d/30d/custom).

rules: Card hovers: subtle lift with box-shadow transition.

accessibility.contrast: APCA/WCAG AA compliant minimum. Ensure chart line colors are distinguishable.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute. (e.g., data-testid='seed-demo-data-btn').

icons.style: Use uniform stroke-width (1.5 or 2). Never use emojis for icons.

media.strategy: No fake testimonials, logos, or avatars. Use clean SVG icons or generic colored letter avatars for users/workspaces.

setup: Add Google Fonts imports for Manrope, IBM Plex Sans, and JetBrains Mono in index.css or index.html.
Configure Tailwind typography for custom fonts in tailwind.config.js.
components: Use Shadcn UI for standard components (Buttons, Inputs, Dialogs, Select, Toast/Sonner) in .js format.
Use Recharts for the Analytics (Spend over time, Reliability, Latency) charts.
Avoid writing complex custom HTML inputs, rely on Shadcn.
implementation: Authentication: Supabase Auth with email + password. Protect dashboard routes.
Build a persistent Sidebar Layout wrapping protected routes.
Dashboard page: Overview KPI cards (Total AI Spend, Requests, Tokens, Avg Cost per Request, Success Rate, Potential Savings) + Spend/Reliability Over Time charts.
Cost analytics: Breakdowns by provider, model, workflow, feature.
Reliability analytics: Success/error rates, latency p50/p95/p99, error trends.
Projects page: Table list of projects. Detail page has API Key management.
API Key Management: 'Create Key' -> Modal -> Shows key once -> 'Copy' -> Close -> Never revealed again.
Usage explorer: Dense tables with global date range filtering.
Optimization: Empty-state page saying 'Optimization intelligence is being prepared from your usage data.'
Manual Seed Demo Data button MUST be present (e.g., in Settings or Top Header).

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for floating headers.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Always specify individual properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file).
Use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use lucide-react.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, and focus states.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
Target environment is React + JavaScript (.js files), DO NOT write .tsx/.ts files.
